learningObjectives: Select and justify extensions to the constellation ui in a business scenario.
Select and justify constellation web embed in a business scenario.
Select and justify constellation dx components in a business scenario.
Select and justify constellation sdks in a business scenario.
Select and justify the constellation dx api in a business scenario.
reviewScope: Official topic comparison and original-question editorial review; not vendor endorsement.

elements.description: Prefer configured Constellation portals and existing view patterns before custom frontend code. Choose the smallest extension that meets the need. A custom portal experience remains governed by the application's case rules and authorization; grouping related information should preserve useful labels and validation.

elements.text: Worked example: A team needs a task-focused portal and grouped contact details. Start with supported portal/view configuration; do not implement a custom design system solely to rearrange a form.

elements.description: Web Embed inserts a Constellation case or page experience into an existing website through generated HTML web-component markup. Configure a Web Embed channel and supported theme options. It uses Constellation rendering rather than giving arbitrary control over every UI implementation detail.

elements.text: Worked example: A retailer adds a service-request form to its existing website with a Web Embed channel's generated markup and supported branding settings.

elements.description: Constellation DX components extend the component library with purpose-specific React components integrated into App Studio view authoring. Use supported APIs and package the component for Pega; only customize when existing patterns do not meet a justified requirement.

elements.text: Worked example: A specialist visual field cannot be expressed by the existing library. Build a supported DX component, upload/package it and verify authoring plus runtime behavior.

elements.description: Constellation SDKs connect Constellation orchestration to alternative design systems and supported frontend frameworks. They reduce work compared with hand-building every orchestration step, but a custom presentation still needs development, testing and upgrade maintenance.

elements.text: Worked example: A company must use its own React design system. Use the appropriate SDK with the Constellation engine, while keeping case workflow and action metadata governed by Pega.

elements.description: The Constellation DX API is a model-driven REST interface exposing case data and view metadata. It uses OAuth 2.0. Preserve response eTag and send it as If-Match on updates to protect against stale writes. Handle conflicts by refreshing and reconciling; do not bypass concurrency checks.

elements.text: Worked example: Fetch assignment action details, render the returned metadata, submit content with the last eTag as If-Match, and refresh when an intervening save causes a conflict.

elements.title: Training environment checklist
items: Implement the worked example in a training application; use synthetic data.
Test the expected path and at least one failure or boundary condition.
Explain why the alternative mechanism would not meet the requirement.
Revisit incorrect answers in Smart Review rather than memorizing option positions.

elements.text: These notes target the '25 exam. Shared Academy pages may show newer labels with '25 applicability; verify screens in your training environment.

examPitfalls.title: Embed versus custom frontend
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Web Embed is a complete arbitrary design-system SDK.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Choose Web Embed for hosted Pega UI; SDKs for an alternative presentation system.

examPitfalls.title: Data versus metadata
examPitfalls.trapDescription: DX responses contain only business fields.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Use view/action metadata as well as case data.

examPitfalls.title: Concurrency
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Force an update when If-Match is stale.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Refresh and reconcile instead of overwriting other changes.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A requirement can be met by configuring an existing Constellation portal. Which approach best limits custom maintenance?

options.text: Create a custom component for every label
Use an unrelated SOAP UI contract
Use supported portal and view configuration
Rebuild all case processing in browser code

practiceQuiz.rationale: Configuration-first design preserves the supported platform behavior and limits unnecessary customization.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

optionExplanations.A: Custom components for ordinary labels create unnecessary maintenance.
optionExplanations.B: An unrelated SOAP contract does not configure a Constellation portal.
optionExplanations.C: Supported portal and view configuration meets the requirement with less custom code.
optionExplanations.D: Rebuilding server case processing in browser code duplicates existing behavior.

practiceQuiz.scenario: An existing website needs a Pega-rendered case form with limited branding changes. Which option fits?
practiceQuiz.rationale: Web Embed places the Constellation experience in an external site using generated web-component markup.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

optionExplanations.A: A work queue stores assignments rather than embedding a form.
optionExplanations.B: Web Embed inserts a Pega-rendered experience into a host website.
optionExplanations.C: Ruleset skimming concerns versions, not embedded UI.
optionExplanations.D: Database Trace diagnoses SQL; it cannot embed a case form.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Where is the generated Web Embed markup configured before insertion into a host page?
practiceQuiz.rationale: The Web Embed channel defines the experience and provides markup for the host website.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

optionExplanations.A: A Web Embed channel configures the experience and generates the host-page markup.
optionExplanations.B: Attachment categories do not generate embedding markup.
optionExplanations.C: An SLA rule controls service goals rather than host-page integration.
optionExplanations.D: A report filter does not configure the embedded case experience.

practiceQuiz.scenario: One specialized field interaction is missing from the Constellation library. Which extension can integrate it into App Studio authoring?

options.text: An untrusted script pasted into every form
A Product rule with no UI component

practiceQuiz.rationale: DX components provide supported component extensions that integrate with view authoring; evaluate existing patterns before building one.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

optionExplanations.A: Pasted untrusted scripts bypass the supported component integration approach.
optionExplanations.B: Packaging alone does not supply the missing UI interaction.
optionExplanations.C: Work Groups organize work ownership, not UI controls.
optionExplanations.D: A supported DX component can extend the Constellation library and App Studio authoring.

practiceQuiz.scenario: An organization must keep its own design system while using Constellation case orchestration. Which option fits?

options.text: A Constellation SDK for the chosen supported framework

practiceQuiz.rationale: SDKs connect Constellation orchestration with an alternative presentation/design system.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

optionExplanations.A: A prerequisite controls ruleset dependencies, not the frontend design system.
optionExplanations.B: Assignment urgency does not provide frontend integration.
optionExplanations.C: A supported Constellation SDK helps integrate case orchestration with the organization's frontend framework.
optionExplanations.D: Default Web Embed styling does not preserve a fully independent design system.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which TWO kinds of information does the model-driven DX response support?

options.text: UI/view metadata and available action information
Only a screenshot of the old portal

practiceQuiz.rationale: The API exposes business data and metadata used to render and act on the case. It does not bypass access control.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

optionExplanations.A: DX requests remain subject to authentication and authorization.
optionExplanations.B: DX responses include case data for the client experience.
optionExplanations.C: View metadata and available actions support model-driven rendering and interaction.
optionExplanations.D: DX returns structured information rather than only a portal screenshot.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A fetched case has an eTag. What should an update send to protect against stale writes?

options.text: That eTag value in the If-Match request header
A random timestamp invented by the client

practiceQuiz.rationale: If-Match carries the previously observed version so the server can detect intervening changes.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

optionExplanations.A: Sending the fetched eTag in If-Match allows the server to detect an intervening update.
optionExplanations.B: An invented timestamp is not the version token returned by the server.
optionExplanations.C: Portal color cannot detect a concurrent case update.
optionExplanations.D: Omitting the required concurrency header does not protect against stale writes.

practiceQuiz.scenario: An update is rejected after another user saved the case. What is the appropriate client behavior?

options.text: Refresh the resource and reconcile the changes

practiceQuiz.rationale: A conflict protects another user's persisted changes. Refresh/reconciliation is required; blindly overwriting defeats concurrency control.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

optionExplanations.A: Unconditional overwrite risks losing the other user's changes.
optionExplanations.B: An arbitrary token cannot establish the current resource version.
optionExplanations.C: Retrying the same stale version does not resolve the conflict.
optionExplanations.D: Refresh the current resource and reconcile changes before submitting with its current token.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which authentication type is required by the Constellation DX API described in this lesson?

options.text: An attachment privilege instead of an authenticated request
A public anonymous API for every action

practiceQuiz.rationale: Constellation DX API uses OAuth 2.0 authentication. Action and data permissions still govern what an authenticated caller may do.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

optionExplanations.A: A theme token is not an authentication credential.
optionExplanations.B: An attachment privilege does not replace request authentication.
optionExplanations.C: The lesson specifies OAuth 2.0 authentication for Constellation DX endpoints.
optionExplanations.D: The described API does not make every action anonymously accessible.

quickRecap.value: Prefer configured Constellation portals and existing view patterns before custom frontend code. Choose the smallest extension that meets the need. A custom portal experience remains governed by the application's case rules and authorization; grouping related information should preserve useful labels and validation.

Web Embed inserts a Constellation case or page experience into an existing website through generated HTML web-component markup. Configure a Web Embed channel and supported theme options. It uses Constellation rendering rather than giving arbitrary control over every UI implementation detail.

Constellation DX components extend the component library with purpose-specific React components integrated into App Studio view authoring. Use supported APIs and package the component for Pega; only customize when existing patterns do not meet a justified requirement.

Constellation SDKs connect Constellation orchestration to alternative design systems and supported frontend frameworks. They reduce work compared with hand-building every orchestration step, but a custom presentation still needs development, testing and upgrade maintenance.

The Constellation DX API is a model-driven REST interface exposing case data and view metadata. It uses OAuth 2.0. Preserve response eTag and send it as If-Match on updates to protect against stale writes. Handle conflicts by refreshing and reconciling; do not bypass concurrency checks.
